question: 'वे दोनों पढ़ते हैं' इत्यस्य शुद्धः संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the correct Sanskrit translation of 'They both read'?) 📖
explanation: Spot on! 'वे दोनों' के लिए द्विवचन 'तौ' का प्रयोग होता है और उसके साथ प्रथम पुरुष द्विवचन की क्रिया 'पठतः' लगती है। 🌟
hint: कर्ता और क्रिया दोनों द्विवचन (Dual number) में होने चाहिए।

question: 'तुम सब जाते हो' अस्य वाक्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'You all go'?) 🚶
explanation: Awesome! 'तुम सब' (You all) translates to 'यूयम्' (Madhyama Purush, Bahuvachan), which takes the verb 'गच्छथ'. ✨
hint: Match the 2nd person plural subject with its verb.

question: 'हम दोनों लिखते हैं' इत्यस्य शुद्धः अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'We both write') ✍️
explanation: Brilliant! 'हम दोनों' translates to 'आवाम्' (Uttama Purush, Dvivachan), so the verb must be 'लिखावः'. 🎉
hint: Look for the first-person dual pronoun and verb.

question: 'वह खेलता है' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'He plays'?) ⚽
explanation: Excellent! 'वह' (He) is 'सः' in pullinga (masculine), taking the singular verb 'क्रीडति'. 🌟
hint: Use the masculine singular pronoun for third person.

question: 'मैं पानी पीता हूँ' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादं चिनुत। (Choose the correct translation for 'I drink water') 💧
explanation: Fantastic! 'मैं' is 'अहम्' (Uttama Purush, Ekavachan) and it takes the verb 'पिबामि'. 🌊
hint: Find the first-person singular subject and verb.

question: 'वे सब बोलते हैं' अस्य अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'They all speak') 🗣️
explanation: Spot on! 'वे सब' translates to the plural 'ते' and the matching verb is 'वदन्ति'. 🏆
hint: Use the third-person plural pronoun and verb.

question: 'तुम देखते हो' इत्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'You see'?) 👀
explanation: Great job! 'तुम' (You) is 'त्वम्' (Madhyama Purush, Ekavachan), which pairs with 'पश्यसि'. 🌟
hint: Match the second-person singular subject with its verb.

question: 'हम सब दौड़ते हैं' अस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'We all run') 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Perfect! 'हम सब' is 'वयम्' (Uttama Purush, Bahuvachan) and the verb is 'धावामः'. 🏃‍♀️
hint: Find the first-person plural pronoun.

question: 'बालिकाएँ गाती हैं' इत्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'The girls sing'?) 🎤
explanation: Awesome! 'बालिकाएँ' is plural (बालिकाः) and requires the plural verb 'गायन्ति'. 🎶
hint: Look for the feminine plural noun and plural verb.

question: 'पत्ते गिरते हैं' अस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'Leaves fall') 🍂
explanation: Excellent! 'पत्ते' is plural 'पत्राणि' (Neuter gender) and takes the plural verb 'पतन्ति'. 🌬️
hint: Identify the neuter plural form of 'Patram'.

question: 'उसने पढ़ा' (Past Tense) अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'He read'?) 📚
explanation: Brilliant! 'उसने' (He) is 'सः', and for past tense (Lang Lakar), we use 'अपठत्'. 🕰️
hint: Look for Lang Lakar, Prathama Purush, Ekavachan.

question: 'तुम दोनों गए' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'You both went') 🚶‍♂️
explanation: Fantastic! 'तुम दोनों' translates to 'युवाम्' and the past tense verb is 'अगच्छतम्'. 🛤️
hint: Find the second-person dual subject and Lang Lakar verb.

question: 'मैंने लिखा' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'I wrote'?) ✍️
explanation: Spot on! 'मैंने' translates to 'अहम्', and the Lang Lakar (past tense) verb for Uttama Purush Ekavachan is 'अलिखम्'. 🖋️
hint: Look for the first-person singular past tense verb.

question: 'उन सबने खेला' इत्यस्य शुद्धः अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'They all played') 🏏
explanation: Great job! 'उन सबने' is 'ते' (plural) and takes the past tense plural verb 'अक्रीडन्'. ⚾
hint: Use the third-person plural pronoun and past tense verb.

question: 'हम सबने देखा' अस्य अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'We all saw'?) 👀
explanation: Awesome! 'हम सबने' translates to 'वयम्' and its matching past tense verb is 'अपश्याम'. 🌟
hint: Look for Uttama Purush Bahuvachan in Lang Lakar.

question: 'तुमने कहा' इत्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'You said') 🗣️
explanation: Perfect! 'तुमने' is 'त्वम्' (singular), and the past tense verb is 'अवदः'. 💬
hint: Find the second-person singular past tense verb.

question: 'हम दोनों हँसे' अस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'We both laughed'?) 😂
explanation: Excellent! 'हम दोनों' translates to 'आवाम्' and its past tense dual verb is 'अहसाव'. 😄
hint: Look for the first-person dual pronoun.

question: 'वह लड़की नाची' इत्यस्य अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'That girl danced') 💃
explanation: Brilliant! 'वह लड़की' is 'सा' (feminine), and the past tense verb is 'अनृत्यत्'. 🎀
hint: Use the feminine singular pronoun and past tense.

question: 'छात्रों ने याद किया' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'The students remembered'?) 🧠
explanation: Fantastic! 'छात्रों ने' is plural 'छात्राः', and the past tense verb is 'अस्मरन्'. 🎓
hint: Look for the plural subject and plural Lang Lakar verb.

question: 'उसने पानी पिया' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'He drank water') 🚰
explanation: Spot on! 'उसने' is 'सः' and 'पिया' is the past tense verb 'अपिबत्'. 🥤
hint: Find the third-person singular past tense verb.

question: 'वह जाएगा' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'He will go'?) 🚶
explanation: Awesome! 'वह' is 'सः' and the future tense (Lrit Lakar) verb is 'गमिष्यति'. 🚀
hint: Look for the Lrit Lakar (future tense) singular verb.

question: 'तुम पढ़ोगे' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'You will read') 📖
explanation: Great job! 'तुम' translates to 'त्वम्' and the future tense verb is 'पठिष्यसि'. 🌟
hint: Match the second-person singular pronoun with its future tense verb.

question: 'मैं खाऊँगा' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'I will eat'?) 🍎
explanation: Excellent! 'मैं' is 'अहम्' and 'खाऊँगा' is 'खादिष्यामि' in Lrit Lakar. 🍕
hint: Look for the first-person singular future tense verb.

question: 'हम दोनों खेलेंगे' इत्यस्य शुद्धः अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'We both will play') 🏸
explanation: Brilliant! 'हम दोनों' is 'आवाम्' and the future dual verb is 'क्रीडिष्यावः'. 🎾
hint: Find the first-person dual pronoun and verb.

question: 'वे सब हँसेंगे' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'They all will laugh'?) 😂
explanation: Perfect! 'वे सब' translates to 'ते' (plural) and takes the future plural verb 'हसिष्यन्ति'. 😆
hint: Look for the third-person plural future tense verb.

question: 'तुम सब लिखोगे' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'You all will write') ✍️
explanation: Fantastic! 'तुम सब' translates to 'यूयम्', matching the future verb 'लेखिष्यथ'. 📝
hint: Find the second-person plural subject and verb.

question: 'हम सब देखेंगे' अस्य अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'We all will see'?) 👁️
explanation: Spot on! 'हम सब' is 'वयम्', and the future tense of the root 'दृश्' is 'द्रक्ष्यामः'. 🔭
hint: Look for the future tense of root 'Drish' in first-person plural.

question: 'वह (स्त्री) पकाएगी' इत्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'She will cook') 🍳
explanation: Awesome! 'वह (स्त्री)' is 'सा' and the future tense of 'पच्' is 'पक्ष्यति'. 🥘
hint: Use the feminine singular pronoun and Lrit Lakar verb.

question: 'तुम दोनों पियोगे' अस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'You both will drink'?) 🥛
explanation: Great job! 'तुम दोनों' translates to 'युवाम्' and the future tense of 'पा' (पिब्) is 'पास्यथः'. 🥤
hint: Find the second-person dual future tense verb.

question: 'फूल खिलेंगे' इत्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'Flowers will bloom') 🌸
explanation: Excellent! 'फूल' (plural) is 'पुष्पाणि' and the future plural verb is 'विकसिष्यन्ति'. 🌻
hint: Look for the neuter plural noun and future tense verb.

question: 'तुम जाओ' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'You go' - Imperative/Order?) 🚶
explanation: Brilliant! 'तुम जाओ' is a command, so we use Lot Lakar. 'त्वम्' pairs with 'गच्छ'. 🚪
hint: Look for the Lot Lakar (Imperative) singular verb.

question: 'उसे पढ़ना चाहिए' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'He should read') 📖
explanation: Fantastic! 'चाहिए' implies Vidhilin Lakar. 'उसे' (सः) pairs with 'पठेत्'. 💡
hint: Find the Vidhilin Lakar (Potential) third-person singular verb.

question: 'हम सब खेलें' अस्य अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'Let us all play') ⚽
explanation: Spot on! This is an imperative (Lot Lakar) sentence for 'वयम्', so the verb is 'क्रीडाम'. 🎯
hint: Look for the Lot Lakar first-person plural verb (without visarga).

question: 'तुम सबको लिखना चाहिए' इत्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'You all should write') ✍️
explanation: Awesome! 'तुम सबको' translates to 'यूयम्', and 'चाहिए' takes Vidhilin Lakar 'लिखेथ'. 📝
hint: Match the second-person plural subject with Vidhilin Lakar.

question: 'मुझे बोलना चाहिए' अस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'I should speak') 🗣️
explanation: Great job! 'मुझे' translates to 'अहम्', and 'चाहिए' indicates Vidhilin Lakar 'वदेयम्'. 🎤
hint: Find the Vidhilin Lakar first-person singular verb.

question: 'वे सब दौड़ें' इत्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'Let them all run') 🏃
explanation: Excellent! This is a command (Lot Lakar) for 'वे सब' (ते), making the verb 'धावन्तु'. 🏁
hint: Look for the third-person plural imperative verb.

question: 'तुम दोनों को पढ़ना चाहिए' अस्य अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'You both should read') 📚
explanation: Brilliant! 'तुम दोनों' is 'युवाम्' and 'चाहिए' takes Vidhilin Lakar dual 'पठेताम्'. 📖
hint: Find the second-person dual Vidhilin Lakar verb.

question: 'मैं जाऊँ?' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'Should I go? / Let me go') 🚶
explanation: Fantastic! Asking for permission uses Lot Lakar. 'अहम्' takes 'गच्छानि'. 🛣️
hint: Look for the Lot Lakar first-person singular verb.

question: 'हम दोनों खाएं' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'Let us both eat') 🍽️
explanation: Spot on! 'हम दोनों' translates to 'आवाम्', and the imperative verb is 'खादाव'. 🍕
hint: Find the Lot Lakar first-person dual verb.

question: 'उसे जाना चाहिए' इत्यस्य अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'He should go') 🚶
explanation: Awesome! 'उसे' is 'सः' and 'चाहिए' takes Vidhilin Lakar 'गच्छेत्'. 🌟
hint: Look for the Vidhilin Lakar third-person singular verb.

question: 'राम के साथ' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'With Ram') 🤝
explanation: Great job! The word 'सह' (with) always governs the Tritiya Vibhakti (Instrumental case), so it becomes 'रामेण सह'. 🎉
hint: Use Tritiya Vibhakti with 'Saha'.

question: 'गाँव के चारो ओर' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'Around the village') 🏡
explanation: Excellent! The word 'परितः' (around) always governs the Dvitiya Vibhakti (Accusative case). 🌲
hint: Use Dvitiya Vibhakti with 'Paritah'.

question: 'पेड़ से पत्ता गिरता है' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'A leaf falls from the tree') 🌳
explanation: Brilliant! Separation (Apadana) requires Panchami Vibhakti. So 'पेड़ से' becomes 'वृक्षात्'. 🌬️
hint: Look for the Panchami Vibhakti indicating separation.

question: 'राजा ब्राह्मण को गाय देता है' इत्यस्य अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'The king gives a cow to the Brahmin') 🐄
explanation: Fantastic! The root 'दा / यच्छ्' (to give) takes Chaturthi Vibhakti (Dative case) for the recipient. 🐮
hint: Use Chaturthi Vibhakti for the person receiving the gift.

question: 'कवियों में कालिदास श्रेष्ठ हैं' अस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'Kalidas is the best among poets') ✍️
explanation: Spot on! When determining superiority among a group (Nirdharana), both Shashthi and Saptami Vibhaktis can be used. 📜
hint: Both Genitive (Shashthi) and Locative (Saptami) cases are correct here.

question: 'यह राम की पुस्तक है' इत्यस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'This is Ram's book') 📚
explanation: Awesome! Relation or possession takes Shashthi Vibhakti (Genitive case), so 'राम की' becomes 'रामस्य'. 🎒
hint: Use the Shashthi Vibhakti for possession.

question: 'वह आँख से अंधा है' अस्य अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'He is blind in one eye') 👁️
explanation: Great job! A physical defect in a body part requires Tritiya Vibhakti (Instrumental case) as per 'येनाङ्गविकारः'. 🩺
hint: Use Tritiya Vibhakti for the defective body part.

question: 'मुझे लड्डू अच्छे लगते हैं' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'I like laddoos') 🍡
explanation: Excellent! The root 'रुच्' (to like/please) requires Chaturthi Vibhakti for the person who likes it. 'अस्मद्' in Chaturthi is 'मह्यम्'. 😋
hint: Use Chaturthi Vibhakti with 'Ruch' dhatu.

question: 'गुरु को नमस्कार' अस्य संस्कृत-अनुवादः कः? (What is the translation of 'Salutations to the Guru') 🙏
explanation: Brilliant! The word 'नमः' always takes the Chaturthi Vibhakti. The Chaturthi of 'गुरु' is 'गुरवे'. 🧘
hint: Use Chaturthi Vibhakti with 'Namah'.

question: 'वह विद्यालय में पढ़ता है' इत्यस्य शुद्ध-अनुवादः कः? (Translate 'He studies in the school') 🏫
explanation: Fantastic! 'विद्यालय में' indicates location (Adhikarana), which requires Saptami Vibhakti (Locative case). 🎓
hint: Use Saptami Vibhakti for the place of action.
